scope: One 45-second seed7/20-car replay per controller, plus six 12-second single-racer cases. Production physics, collisions, NPC AI and inputs are unmodified. In-memory observation only; no forced route choices.
crossingDefinition: Real front-to-rear z=0 crossing in a frame with visible/non-waiting NPC both before and after, negative old z, nonnegative new z, and positive world displacement less than 20 m. This excludes the roughly 500 m respawn/waiting teleport jumps.
rejectionDefinition: Candidate passed first-step safety, remains collision-free for all 3.6s and advances more physical metres than staying, but fails the unchanged production score test. Waiting counts only decisions at which no other candidate was accepted.

latestFocusedTests.pendingOwnershipDelta: readDriveInput/readAttitudeInput select demo neutral input for isBusy rather than isActive; no controller change
latestFocusedTests.matrixEquivalence: PASS: matrix fixture isActive/isBusy are both constant true; old/new production input readers return identical drive and grounded/airborne attitude results for five neutral/throttle/boost/brake/steer/strafe input samples. This equivalence applies to the matrix fixture, not to real pending UI state.
